guidance: We expected performance to improve sequentially fromQ2, followed by a return to year-on-year growth in the second half.
While Pharma CDMO revenues remain lower by 27% year-on-year in Q2 and 32% in H1, we expect the sequential momentum to sustain through the H2.
capex: Our bioconjugation capacity expansion remains on track for commercial availability by early FY2028, further strengthening our end-to-end ADC offering.
risks: Before we begin, I would like to remind you that today’s discussion may include forward-looking statements that are subject to risk and uncertainties.
Selective price pass-throughs are helping mitigate part of the pressure.
focus: I will build on Umang’s comments and focus on the operating progress across small molecules, ADCs, and nucleic acids.

Our energy is therefore focused on using the existing network more effectively and adding capability where required to support scale-up and larger customer programs rather than creating standalone capacity.
Alongside the long-term opportunities, we are creating through new products, regulated market development, and greater participation across the pharmaceutical value chain.
quals: Building on the customer qualification and regulatory progress we discussed last quarter, we received further commercial orders during Q2 across several established products.
Targeted automation and environmental upgrades at our multipurpose Agrochemical facility, together with a dedicated R&D laboratory, are intended to speed up new customer qualification process.
FY 27 is therefore an important qualification and portfolio transition year.

about: Cohance Lifesciences is a Hyderabad-based CDMO operating across pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, APIs, formulations and specialty chemicals. The company states that it features among the Top 20 CDMOs globally; its Pharma CDMO business works with 19 of the top 20 global innovators, while the API portfolio ranks among the top three suppliers in 8 of its top 10 molecules.
